name: Tomato toast
intro: Thick sourdough, a ripe tomato, olive oil, salt. In July, that's dinner — add an egg if you want it to be.

variations.context: The default. Tomato, egg, a spoonful of vinaigrette.
Torn burrata under the tomato, basil over it.
Charred salsa instead of fresh tomato.

finish: Toast the bread in a skillet with olive oil until it's crisp. Rub the cut side of a garlic clove over it while it's hot, then pile on the tomato, salt it, and eat it standing up if you want.
